summary: Wrote a seven-phase, 11-hour plan for the isolation-off landing verification: a V1-V5 predicate script with observed-failing negative fixtures, a postflight reorder, an unconditional exit-7 gate in update-task-status.sh, unwiring of milestone-ref-land.sh and a re-pointed review handoff, then redeploy. Plan-time re-validation found the report's completion-caller list incomplete and one of its defect claims partly stale; both are recorded in the plan and the issue log. No user decision is raised.

artifacts.summary: Seven-phase plan for the landing verification gate, proof record and milestone-ref-land retirement.
